Title: Bima and cards that requires an anarch

Messages.Author: kleberjf
Messages.Body:
Hello!

Bima can play cards that requires an anarch?

Ghoul with 2 life. 2 strength, 1 bleed.
After Bima enters play, put a master Discipline card from your hand on it or burn Bima. Bima can play cards requiring the basic level of that Discipline as a vampire.

Cheer´s

Kleber

No. Bima can only "mimic" a Discipline, not a sect. You can compare it to Grey Thorne;

Name: Grey Thorne
[TR:R]
Cardtype: Ally
Cost: 2 blood
Unique ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed. Requires an anarch.
Grey may play cards that require Celerity [cel] or Potence [pot] as an {A}narch vampire. During your unlock phase, if Grey has only 1 life, any ready anarch may burn a blood to add 1 life to him.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
